goal: Measure how available Origami knowledge can grow while the model-facing active context remains fixed.

work_accounting.reason: A bounded ContextPacket is not a valid success if it hides an uncontrolled whole-memory scan or preprocessing step.

quality_metrics.carrier_top1_accuracy: fraction of positive queries whose target carrier ranks first
quality_metrics.carrier_recall_at_k: fraction of positive queries whose target carrier is inside the selected carrier set
quality_metrics.target_hit_accuracy: fraction of positive queries exposing at least one target-carrier item
quality_metrics.evidence_hit_accuracy: fraction of positive queries exposing target evidence
quality_metrics.negative_unknown_accuracy: fraction of negative queries that fail closed as UNKNOWN with zero exposed tokens
quality_metrics.useful_context_efficiency: target-carrier tokens divided by all exposed tokens
quality_metrics.routing_selectivity: average selected carriers divided by total carriers
quality_metrics.exposure_fraction: average unfolded nodes divided by total available nodes

promotion_boundary.deterministic_runtime: This lab can establish routing/unfolding behavior and work accounting.
promotion_boundary.model_quality: Not established by this lab; model-facing evaluation consumes the same trace/query cases in a later phase.
